phase_name: Independent Audit of Phase 0H-1 Data Governance Integration Discovery

component_count_reconciliation.notes: Discovery artifact correctly lists 14 unique component IDs; prior narrative summary incorrectly stated 12.

metadata_semantic_audit.repository_evidence: ohlcv_data.open_time and market_events.start_time/end_time represent when the underlying market interval or event occurred (blackdark/data/migrations/003_ohlcv_data.sql, 006_market_events.sql).
metadata_semantic_audit.semantic_limitations: hot_tier_reader.fetch_recent_closes returns price floats without timestamps; quote-age metrics are not event_time.

metadata_semantic_audit.repository_evidence: stale_price_guard.validate_venue_quote and data_provenance_score expose quote_age_ms/freshness_ms (relative latency), not an absolute observation timestamp on contract surfaces.
metadata_semantic_audit.semantic_limitations: live_book_hub stores ISO timestamp on book updates, but observed_time is not propagated through audited DG→Temporal contract return payloads without ambiguous reconstruction from age alone.

metadata_semantic_audit.repository_evidence: blackdark/data/response_metadata.resolve_data_state compares latest_record_at to SLA freshness thresholds; no available_at field exists in schemas or APIs.
metadata_semantic_audit.semantic_limitations: latest_record_at reflects latest stored record event time, not earliest availability to a Temporal point-in-time process.

metadata_semantic_audit.repository_evidence: ohlcv_data.fetched_at column exists (003_ohlcv_data.sql); data_provenance.parsed_at aliased fetched_at in get_provenance_by_record; ingestion_runs.started_at records run start.
metadata_semantic_audit.semantic_limitations: parsed_at is parse time, not proven record-level storage time; ingestion_runs.started_at is run-level not per-record; query_ohlcv read path does not return fetched_at.

metadata_semantic_audit.repository_evidence: No effective_at column or equivalent domain-effectiveness timestamp located in inspected DG schemas or services.
data_sources.updated_at exists on registry rows (blackdark/data/models.py DataSource) only.
metadata_semantic_audit.semantic_limitations: Registry metadata update time is not event/datum revision time; no revision chain proven for market_events or ohlcv_data.

metadata_semantic_audit.repository_evidence: data_sources_registry.DataSourceSpec.source_id; Postgres data_sources.slug; provenance joins expose ds.slug AS source.
metadata_semantic_audit.semantic_limitations: market_events carries source_links JSONB rather than normalized source slug.

metadata_semantic_audit.repository_evidence: data_provenance.parser_version and PARSER_VERSION constant record parser implementation version only.
metadata_semantic_audit.semantic_limitations: Upstream data-producing source release/version semantics are not stored; parser_version is not equivalent to Temporal source_version.

metadata_semantic_audit.repository_evidence: No dataset_version field, snapshot id, or version table found in inspected DG paths.
Provenance lineage: raw_response_hash, source_endpoint, source_links JSONB, ingestion_run_id (provenance.py, market_events). Rights: DataSourceSpec.env_key indicates credential requirement only.
metadata_semantic_audit.semantic_limitations: env_key/notes do not prove licensing entitlement or usage rights; provenance and rights must not be treated as equivalent.
